title: Hi! I’m Pilot.
subtitle: Your AI business assistant.
description: I’ll help keep your customers, appointments, conversations, and day-to-day business tasks organized — all in one place.

steps.title: Know your business
steps.description: Teach Pilot your services, hours, pricing, policies, FAQs, and service area.

steps.title: Keep work moving
steps.description: Use customer history, appointments, and follow-ups to stay ready for the next task.

steps.title: Support your receptionist
steps.description: Set clear behavior, boundaries, and handoff guidance for customer conversations.

promptDescription: Share a short introduction in your own words. Pilot will save it as starting context for your workspace.
placeholder: We’re a plumbing company in Windsor. We handle residential plumbing, water heaters, drains, and emergency repairs.
response: Thanks — I’ll use that as your starting business context. You can add the details next.
